contracts.boundary: committed ast-grep rules and fixtures, Semgrep rules and fixtures, Gitleaks config, Renovate policy, and workflow YAML
contracts.assertions: Ast-grep rules pass their fixtures; Semgrep rule IDs match fixture names with valid and invalid examples; the secret allowlist is rule-scoped; every action is pinned and every checkout isolates credentials; the dispatch-only audit runs every scanner.

boundaryTest.name: the committed Semgrep rules and fixtures share exact rule identifiers and file names

fault.name: the credential-persistence check rejects a checkout that omits the setting
